description: Read-only probe for KOREA-DRIVE-001 (owner 2026-11-17: the drive and a colour filter for the auction lots). Bounded run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run source_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which uses the installed collector and the owner login file to read the first Korea search page and up to 40 lot pages, and reports their colour field and the markup around the colour and trim labels (VIN and long numbers masked). No bid, no source, CRM, HTML, media or bot change.
title: Korea lot page colour probe
